professionalSummary.text: Embedded software engineer with five years of experience implementing controller functions against machine engineers' specifications under the team's software standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Embedded software engineer on the harvester controller team of an agricultural machinery maker for five years, implementing controller functions against the machine engineers' function specifications under the team's software standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Tested each function on the bench rig with rig test records attached to the change, supporting the field test programme for two harvest seasons with diagnostics from controller logs.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented release limitations and hand-over conditions in each release note for the field test team.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience implementing functions, testing on bench rig, supporting field tests, taking changes through review, coordinating with machine engineers, and documenting releases. The materials do not establish the candidate's role in release approval, the specific software standard, or the exact nature of the machine engineers' specifications.
